(I want to win...!
I want to beat Logo!! I 
want to win,
I want to win—I don't want to 
lose!!)

now!! I'll win, I can win! —I MUST 
WIN!!!!)

text_block_list.text:
Woooooooaaaahhhhhhh-! Aaaaaaaalllllll 
rrrrrrrrriiiiiiiggggggghhhhhhht!!

text_block_list.text:
"Whoa...?!" "Is that voice... Epi?!" 
"Th-This is completely out of control!!" 
—"Can she hold out until the very end...?"
choice_data_list: Hang in there, Epi...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, crap...!" "Should I go now?!" 
"...Ngh, no, I can't let her throw off my 
pace—"
choice_data_list: Hang in there, Epi...!!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
…………――Don't rush. Run your own race... at 
your own pace――!!

text_block_list.text: I won!!!!

text_block_list.text:
"Congrats,
Epi!" "That was incredible...!" 
"She actually won from that position!?" 
"She's so strong...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though there was a precarious moment, 
cheers erupt for her brilliant victory. 
However—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
It felt like... she won on pure momentum 
alone. Which is still insane for a G1, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... The Derby is longer, so it might 
be tough at this rate, don't you think? 
Though she might just pull it off on raw 
talent alone."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ……Hm?

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: Ah...... Damn it.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Logo! Great job out there~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
You ran with such confidence, it was 
amazing...! To me, you looked brighter 
than anyone else...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Only Logo...
stayed true to his 
own race. Such incredible grit in an 
atmosphere like that.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of girl Logo-chan
is... 
Heh. Apparently her family runs a sign 
shop.

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
"Sign makers? They're still around today! 
I'll look into it a bit more when I get 
back~."

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"...I won't change my style. I'll sharpen 
it even more—and head for the Derby!"

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"You know...
Logo-chan seems pretty cool." 
"I think I'll root for her in the Derby 
too♪" "...Huh, she's the daughter of a 
signboard shop owner?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I won, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Congratulations, Epi!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You're right! We should be celebrating! 
And yet――
choice_data_list: Congratulations, Epi!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is looking at the logo! As if 
they feel a sense of destiny in it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That makes no sense! I was the one who 
won, wasn't I?!
choice_data_list: Even so, support for Logo ended up...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Getting results isn't the only way to 
captivate hearts. Logotype's run today 
gave it everything she had—it was truly 
magnificent."
choice_data_list: Even so, the support for the logo ...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: No! Just the way you are is fine!!
choice_data_list: ...Maybe we need to change somethi...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny says so too!
It says 
keep going, go as far as we can!"
choice_data_list: (Well, that makes sense—)
(Well, I guess that's true—)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Still,
I understand what you're saying, 
too!
choice_data_list: (Well, I guess so—)
(Well, that's true, I suppose—)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The reality is,
Logo got what I wanted. If 
I stay the way I am now, it's just not 
going to cut it.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then... what do you think you need to 
change?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The kind of interest Epiphaneia seeks is 
so intense that people "feel destiny" in 
her. Merely being liked isn't enough; 
what's needed is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, she can't hold back her 
overflowing fighting spirit and is
running purely on instinct,
but... if she comes to 
terms with her feelings and claims a 
flawless victory at the Nippon Derby――"
choice_data_list: Stay disciplined when you run.
Make sure you stay disciplined whe...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
choice_data_list: I'm sure more girls will feel that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's usually one for quick decisions,
yet 
now she's deep in thought... Honestly, I 
expected her to answer, "Even so,
I'll run however I please," but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Got it! I'll follow your lead!
choice_data_list: Are you sure? Even if it's a diffe...
Are you sure? Even if it's a diffe...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if it's the right thing to 
do! But still—!
choice_data_list: Are you sure? Even though it's a d...
Are you sure? Even though it's a d...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely want to win the Derby!! I 
don't want a repeat of what happened 
today!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I will never allow such a thing! I'll 
win, and make everyone feel destiny at 
work!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Up until today, I ran while being pushed 
forward by everyone's voices. So this 
time—I'm believing in you!
choice_data_list: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having her follow our instructions
instead 
of the voice of destiny. I already know 
full well just how unprecedented that is 
for her.
choice_data_list: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
